objects.description: During the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) used administrative accounts to connect over SMB to targeted users.(Citation: CrowdStrike StellarParticle January 2022)
